propositions: When plan review passes but attestation write fails due to lock timeout and the PASS sidecar was not persisted, sign-review recovery guidance is advertised but cannot work because the sidecar is missing
classify_plan_review_attestation catch-all branch reaches non-material failures including lock timeouts but never inspects sidecar_emitted field, causing incorrect recovery_tool classification
When sidecar_emitted is false after sign failure, the system retains a stale contradicting verdict from the previous round instead of no verdict, misleading users into reading it as current

A new ATTESTATION_SIDECAR_LOST cause must be added ahead of the catch-all, branching when sign failure occurs and sidecar_emitted is explicitly False, with recovery_tool directed to review-plan instead of sign-review
